rules: Use scores only to rank and organize vacancies; never automatically reject or hide a vacancy because of its score.
Keep low-scoring and uncertain matches visible for human review.
Score evidence in the job description, not keyword frequency alone.
Distinguish mandatory requirements from preferred qualifications.
Treat missing or unclear information as unknown, not as a confirmed mismatch or an automatic zero.
Interpret location, language, compensation, and work authorization in the context of the vacancy's country.
Do not infer visa sponsorship, salary, language level, or remote eligibility when not stated; mark unknown.
Explain every score with supporting job-description evidence and candidate experience evidence.
A score is decision support, not a probability of getting an interview.
Normalize compensation only when reliable exchange-rate and pay-period data are available; otherwise preserve the original value.
